signals.title: Anthropic Compliance API extends enterprise audit visibility to local Cowork and Claude Code sessions
signals.title_zh: Anthropic Compliance API 将企业审计可见性扩展到本地 Cowork 与 Claude Code 会话
signals.summary: Claude Enterprise can list local sessions, retrieve session metadata, and retrieve transcripts for Cowork and Claude Code activity running on users' machines through Compliance API endpoints guarded by the existing compliance access key and read:compliance_user_data scope.
signals.summary_zh: Claude Enterprise 可通过 Compliance API 枚举用户机器上的本地 Cowork / Claude Code 会话、读取会话元数据与转录，并继续使用既有 Compliance Access Key 与 read:compliance_user_data 权限域。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains adds cross-session memory with enterprise-managed agent controls
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 增加跨会话记忆与企业级 Agent 管理控制
signals.summary: The JetBrains release adds persistent Copilot memory across agent chat sessions while exposing organization-level controls for plugin availability, MCP access, permission bypass behavior, and OpenTelemetry settings.
signals.summary_zh: JetBrains 版本增加跨 Agent Chat 会话的持久 Copilot Memory，并提供插件可用性、MCP 访问、权限绕过行为与 OpenTelemetry 的组织级控制。

signals.title: GitHub Copilot usage reports expose per-model token and cache-cost composition
signals.title_zh: GitHub Copilot 使用报告公开每模型 Token 与缓存成本构成
signals.summary: AI usage reports now break each model's credit consumption into input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens, strengthening cost attribution for governed agent workloads.
signals.summary_zh: AI 使用报告现在按模型拆分输入、输出、缓存读取与缓存写入 Token，并对应 AI Credit 消耗，增强受治理 Agent 工作负载的成本归因。

signals.title: Codex changes queued-user-message admission to resolve at Core acceptance
signals.title_zh: Codex 将排队用户消息的接纳时点改为 Core 接受时
signals.summary: Queued input is now considered admitted when Core accepts it as a new turn or steer, rather than after rollout persistence; the queue entry is deleted at acceptance even if a later prompt hook stops the turn.
signals.summary_zh: 排队输入现在在 Core 接受为新 Turn 或 Steer 时即视为已接纳，而不是等 Rollout 持久化；即使后续 Prompt Hook 停止 Turn，队列项也在接纳时删除。

signals.title: Codex MCP OAuth registration prefers CIMD with validated DCR fallback
signals.title_zh: Codex MCP OAuth 注册优先使用 CIMD，并保留经校验的 DCR 回退
signals.summary: Automatic MCP OAuth registration can select Client ID Metadata Documents for native-loopback public clients, fall back to advertised DCR, and validates CIMD metadata and callback URLs before authorization.
signals.summary_zh: MCP OAuth 自动注册可为原生 Loopback 公共客户端选择 Client ID Metadata Documents，并回退到服务端声明的 DCR；授权前会校验 CIMD 元数据和回调 URL。

signals.title: Codex unifies MCP tool approvals under ReviewDecision with persistent policy amendments
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 MCP 工具审批统一到 ReviewDecision，并支持持久策略修订
signals.summary: MCP approval responses now use the shared ReviewDecision contract, including a persistent ApprovedMcpPolicyAmendment while preserving session approvals, rejection reasons, timeouts, and cancellations and rejecting MCP-only decisions in non-MCP approval paths.
signals.summary_zh: MCP 审批响应统一使用 ReviewDecision，并新增可跨会话持久的 ApprovedMcpPolicyAmendment；同时保留会话审批、拒绝原因、超时与取消，并阻止 MCP 专用决策进入非 MCP 审批路径。

signals.title: Codex gRPC code-mode callbacks gain explicit ownership, cancellation, limits, and concurrent-session isolation
signals.title_zh: Codex gRPC Code Mode 回调增加显式所有权、取消、限额与并发会话隔离
signals.summary: Nested tool and notification callbacks are forwarded to session delegates with bounded results/errors, explicit callback ownership and cancellation, validation of cell ownership and enabled tools, and non-serialized independent sessions.
signals.summary_zh: 嵌套工具与通知回调现在转发给 Session Delegate，并具有结果/错误上限、显式回调所有权与取消、Cell 所有权和启用工具校验，同时保持独立会话不被串行化。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK deterministically closes model streams on terminal streamed-turn failures
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在流式 Turn 终止失败时确定性关闭模型流
signals.summary: The runner now explicitly aclose()s streaming generator chains when terminal events raise out of the loop, preventing cleanup from waiting on garbage collection and ensuring a failed run releases shared websocket request locks for waiting runs.
signals.summary_zh: Runner 在终止事件导致流式循环抛错时显式 aclose() 生成器链，避免清理依赖垃圾回收，并确保失败 Run 释放共享 WebSocket 请求锁，使等待中的 Run 能继续。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK isolates MCP manager lifecycle results from manager-owned active state
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 将 MCP Manager 生命周期返回值与 Manager 自有活动状态隔离
signals.summary: connect_all() and reconnect() now return copied active-server lists, so callers mutating a lifecycle result cannot mutate MCPServerManager's internal active-server state; regression tests enforce this ownership boundary.
signals.summary_zh: connect_all() 与 reconnect() 现在返回活动服务器列表副本，调用方修改生命周期返回值不会再修改 MCPServerManager 内部活动状态；回归测试固定了这一所有权边界。

signals.title: Claude Code 2.1.228 fixes background-task handoff that could prematurely end self-hosted sessions
signals.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.228 修复后台任务交接导致自托管会话提前结束的问题
signals.summary: The release fixes self-hosted runners ending a session in the gap between a background task finishing and the follow-up turn starting, a direct long-running-work continuity boundary; the same release also hardens synced skill execution boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: 该版本修复 Self-hosted Runner 在后台任务结束与后续 Turn 启动之间的间隙提前终止会话的问题，直接涉及长任务连续性边界；同版还强化了同步 Skill 的执行边界。

signals.title: Google ADK fixes sync streaming completion that raised RuntimeError after the final chunk
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 修复同步流在最后一个 Chunk 后错误抛出 RuntimeError 的完成语义
signals.summary: The stream_reasoning_engine adapter now uses a sentinel rather than allowing StopIteration to cross an await boundary, so synchronous generators terminate cleanly instead of logging RuntimeError after every completed stream.
signals.summary_zh: stream_reasoning_engine 适配器改用 Sentinel，避免 StopIteration 穿越 await 边界，使同步生成器在最终 Chunk 后干净结束，而不是每次完成流都记录 RuntimeError。
